note: Lonnie's crew and similar street toughs. Threat without slurs; scripted encounters mostly.

lines.text: Nice night. Shame to waste it.
Lonnie says hello. Lonnie says a lot of things.
You bumped me. Now we got a problem.
He's heading for Penn Station! Cut him off!
Envelope looks heavy, collector. Want help carrying it?
Lost him. Lonnie's gonna be sore.
